{{Top|leg}}
A '''Tionese program''' was a type of [[Computer/Legends|computer]] virus. In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], the agents of [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] leader [[Iaco Stark/Legends|Iaco Stark]] infected the [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computers]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin's]] [[Outland Regions Security Force/Legends|military force]] with a Tionese program. When Tarkin's forces subsequently jumped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], the virus caused two thirds of Tarkin's force to be randomly scattered to destinations across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
